notes.title: UPDATE 1.3.0 RELEASE
notes.notes:
[h1]1. Endless mode (beta) added [/h1]
 -Endless mode with no round limit has been applied.
 -Applying a map exclusively for endless mode that provides more tiles.
 -One phase consists of 5 rounds, and each phase has different properties, appearance position and 
 bosses.
 -Survive longer and challenge the best score.
 -Currently, the endless mode is a beta version, and there may be bugs and balance problems.
 -We will listen to your opinions and distribute the full version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37493265/4b4dbe093b20eef0bb9fd161d7e273aa0a6fba73.jpg[/img]

[h1]2. Profile system (beta) added[/h1]
 -A profile feature has been added to check your play information.
 -You can display the badge you want.
 -The current profile system is a beta version, and there may be bugs.
 -We will listen to your opinions and distribute the full version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37493265/def5a9fb0c3816148fa233927fb01a9cfb05a9cc.jpg[/img]


[h1]Apology's Word[/h1]
 -The promised update has been delayed for more than a month.
 -We apologize to all who have been waiting for this update.
 -Because we are a small team, we had to do various things to survive.
 -So, this update is unavoidably delayed.
 -We had promised an update we couldn't keep.
 -We are sorry.
 -Next time, I will make a promise that I can keep.
 -This update also lacks a lot.
 -If you give us your feedback, we will try to fix it steadily even if it is late.
 -Thank you.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2.0 RELEASE
notes.notes:
[h3]1. Trophy
[/h3]
 - Now you can get trophies according to the stage clear result in challenge mode.
 - There are 3 types: Clear Trophy, Mission Complete Trophy, and HP Trophy.
[list]
[*] Clear Trophy: The trophy you get when you clear each stage.
[*] Mission Trophy: When you clear each stage, you get it by completing all 6 missions (3 basic and 3 hidden).
[*] HP Trophy: When you clear each stage, you get more than 30 HP remaining.
[/list]
 - Trophies are automatically registered for users who have already cleared the stage according to their clear record.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37493265/0c67c27bfab80df6f0270b8092269ab75edeef70.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37493265/ac07204c6ed7c7db4cab5ee74099c8e33a664dfc.png[/img]

[h3]2. Tech Tree
[/h3]
 - The trophy you collected can be converted into a tech point and used to develop skills for clearing the stage.
     [i] (1 trophy = 1 tech point)[/i]

 - You can increase the maximum HP or weaken the enemy by using the tech tree.
 - Alternatively, you can speed up the Goldmon summon cycle for higher scores, or increase your gold gains.
 - Use the tech tree to challenge high difficulty or aim for high scores!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37493265/8c031a821dda39ede49c7191630df9e2d3e358a4.png[/img]


[h3] 3. Change of applied value according to type
[/h3]
 -In the battle, the dependence on each type has increased.
[b]-Original:
[/b][list]
[*] Fire -> Water -> Forest: 66%
[*] Forest -> Water -> Fire: 133%
[/list]
[b]-Change:
[/b][list]
[*] Fire -> Water -> Forest: 33%
[*] Forest -> Water -> Fire: 166%
[/list]

[h3] 4. Both hands can be used
[/h3]
 -Now you can play with both hands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37493265/aae68b6a7b8dc17bcdf05d8a2b5a15664f2af88b.png[/img]

[h3] 5. Difficulty change for each stage
[/h3]
 -Overall, the difficulty of the stage has gradually increased.
 -Defend against enemy attacks using the tech tree.

[h3] 6. Etc
[/h3]
 -UI information window change
 -Some texture changes
 -Other bug fixes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37493265/9e38261077551f40d77c7ed090625b100874a35b.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 delay notice
notes.notes:
Hello?

Dear fans of Project RTD VR.

It is JAMONG.

Originally, the 1.2.0 version was scheduled to be updated at the end of June.

During development, we concluded that additional testing and verification was necessary due to various problems.

Unfortunately, the update has been postponed to [b]mid-July [/b].

We will update the Tech-Tree system first, and the profile system will be updated later.

We apologize for not following the promise.

Thank you.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1.4 RELEASE !
notes.notes:
[h3]1. Difficulty name change
[/h3]: Existing 'Easy' is changed to 'Normal' and 'Normal' is changed to 'Hard'. In 'Hard' mode, 'Unlimited wait time' and 'Slow' functions are disabled.

[h3]2. Slow function added
[/h3]: Slow motion function is activated by selecting a tower during in-game or opening the menu. Now you can enjoy the battle more comfortably or devise a strategy. This feature only works on 'Normal' difficulty.

[h3] 3. Tower status and attack speed fixes
[/h3]: Some tower status and attack bugs to be applied to version 1.2.0 were fixed and applied a little earlier.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that applied a lot of skill damage to Shi, Pulsar, and Karian.
[*] Fixed a bug in which the attack speed of Endless, Netra, etc. was incorrectly applied.
[/list]

[h3] 4. Other
[/h3] [list]
[*] In the tutorial, the position of the explanation window and in-game round start button has been slightly changed.
[*] Minor bugs were fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE PREVIEW 1.1.0
notes.notes:
[b] Introducing the first update of Project RTD VR. [/b]

[b] 1. Unlimited Ready Time [/b]
  -We have found that you are struggling on several stages of RTD VR. And I found that there wasn't enough time to explore the abilities of RTD VR's attractive 30 towers. So we decided to add an 'unlimited ready time' feature. This feature prevents you from starting a new round until you are ready. During that time, you can build and synthesize enough towers. However, the play time continues, so it can be disadvantageous for high scores. You can turn the feature on or off in Settings.

[b] 2. Steam Achievement[/b]
-We are making Steam 'Achievement' to reward your challenge. We are preparing more than 40 achievements.

[b] 3, Left hand available[/b]
-You can also play with your left hand. You can set up your left hand play through the 'Settings' menu. It cannot be changed during gameplay.

[b] 4, Other[/b]
 -Teresa and Netra's modeling has been slightly modified and some bugs fixed.
 -We are preparing to support valve index controller. If possible, we are working hard to forge this update. However, it may be postponed to the next update.

[b] * Update schedule[/b]
-Scheduled for the first Friday in June.
